page_title: ACM 3-3 SAL | AC Milan v Salernitana 25/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+5' Mattia Caldara (AC Milan) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Salernitana will have a goal kick.

90+4' Referee Davide Di Marco sees the trip by Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. AC Milan win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
90+3' A quickly taken corner by AC Milan.

90+2' Alessandro Florenzi floats the corner into the six-yard box, but the ball spins off the head of Luka Jovic (AC Milan) and falls to safety well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Salernitana will have a goal kick.
90+2' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' 3 - 3 Goal! Simy (Salernitana) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 3:3.
89' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) produces a promising shot towards the left side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Antonio Mirante thwarts him and the score remains the same.
88' Substitution. Simon Kjaer (AC Milan) in, Fikayo Tomori out.
88' Stefano Pioli has decided to substitute Antonio Mirante and he is replaced by Lapo Nava (AC Milan).

87' 3 - 2 Goal! Junior Sambia (Salernitana) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Antonio Mirante is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 3:2.
86' Yacine Adli (AC Milan) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Olivier Giroud leaves the pitch and Luka Jovic (AC Milan) comes on.
84' The corner from Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) is intercepted by the defence.
83' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
82' Stefano Colantuono has decided to make a change. Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) replaces Alessandro Zanoli.
82' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Giulio Maggiore as he is replaced by Andres Sfait (Salernitana).

80' Loum Tchaouna floats a good corner into the box that Niccolo Pierozzi (Salernitana) gets on the end of, but his effort on goal scorches just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
80' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) prepares to take a corner kick.

77' 3 - 1 Christian Pulisic shows his great technique and produces a beautiful cross into the box. Davide Calabria (AC Milan) gets on the scoresheet by heading the ball precisely inside the right post. It's now 3:1.
77' Davide Di Marco interrupts the game. One of the players from Salernitana won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
77' The AC Milan players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
75' We are about to witness a subsitution. Marco Pellegrino (Salernitana) for Norbert Gyomber.
74' A player from Salernitana commits a rough challenge. Davide Di Marco blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
72' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the roof of the net. Vincenzo Fiorillo is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.

70' A fine solo run by Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
69' Neat passing move from Salernitana in order to create new attacking opportunities.
66' A header by Simy (Salernitana) from very close range goes towards the top right corner, but doesn't get past Antonio Mirante, who makes a brilliant save.
64' 2 - 1 Junior Sambia takes over corner duties and expertly finds Simy (Salernitana), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the back of the net. The score is now 2:1.
64' Junior Sambia (Salernitana) steps up to send the ball in.
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Emanuel Vignato (Salernitana) is coming onto the pitch as Antonio Candreva cannot continue after picking up an injury.
60' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Grigoris Kastanos walks off the pitch to be replaced by Simy (Salernitana).
59' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Antonio Mirante stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
59' Today's match ends for Rafael Leao who will be replaced by Yacine Adli (AC Milan).
58' Stefano Pioli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mattia Caldara (AC Milan) replacing Matteo Gabbia.
58' Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Davide Di Marco blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Salernitana.
56' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
53' One of the players from Salernitana times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
51' Niccolo Pierozzi (Salernitana) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Davide Di Marco had an easy-decision to make.
50' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
48' Norbert Gyomber (Salernitana) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
46' A pass by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

45+1' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the top right corner. Vincenzo Fiorillo shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net. The ball goes out of play. AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
45+1' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) takes a short corner kick.

45+1' The opposition back off Theo Hernandez (AC Milan), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort towards the bottom left corner, but Vincenzo Fiorillo denies him with the save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to AC Milan.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Antonio Mirante, who smothers the ball.
43' Dangerous play by Theo Hernandez (AC Milan). Davide Di Marco blows his whistle for a foul. Salernitana are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
43' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
40' AC Milan quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
40' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Now AC Milan have a corner.
38' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The AC Milan players look gutted.
38' The AC Milan players halt their celebrations as referee Davide Di Marco makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
37' Goal! Rafael Leao provides Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom right corner. 3:0.
36' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
34' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
32' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

32' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. AC Milan force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
32' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
31' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) will take a corner kick.
30' The total number of attempts is 9:2. The current number of shots on goal is 5:0.

27' 2 - 0 Alessandro Florenzi produces a cross from the resulting corner and finds Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) inside the box. He pulls the trigger and scores, sending the ball inside the left post. What a brilliant finish. 2:0.
27' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
26' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) commits a rough foul. Davide Di Marco stops the game and makes a call.
22' 1 - 0 Goal! Vincenzo Fiorillo makes a huge mistake and Rafael Leao (AC Milan) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 1:0.
21' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AC Milan.
20' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. AC Milan have a corner.
20' The AC Milan players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

17' Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Davide Di Marco with no other option than to blow for a foul.

15' Alessandro Florenzi floats over the corner and Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) gets on the end of it, but his header from around the penalty spot sails well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Salernitana will have a goal kick.
15' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

15' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. Good work from AC Milan as they win a corner.

13' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Salernitana.
11' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
8' 88:12 – the ratio of ball possession.
6' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

6' The ball is cleared after Rafael Leao (AC Milan) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. AC Milan will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
6' AC Milan enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
3' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
3' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Vincenzo Fiorillo has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
2' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save!
2' The AC Milan players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Salernitana will kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to ceremony.
Davide Di Marco is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
